english.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday equivalent for a general recent-time reference.
This is the all-purpose choice for saying something happened recently or has been true of late.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for recently or lately when the time span is not restricted to just now.
Use this for something that happened recently, rather than for being behind schedule.

examples.english: I have recently been unable to sleep well.
